family.description: This entry represents the N-terminal, pre-PUA domain of yeast 60S ribosome subunit biogenesis protein NIP7 and homologues, some uncharacterised proteins from the UPF0113 family and similar sequences from eukaryotes and some archaeal species. NIP7 is required for proper 27S pre-rRNA processing and 60S ribosome subunit assembly. This domain is found associated with [pfam:PF03657].
family.name: NIP7/UPF0113, pre-PUA domain
